title: Amazing app to build habits
body:
Finch is an amazing app with a lot of free features to improve your life and mental health. Since I started using it (currently on a 200-day streak), I’ve managed to build and maintain several essential habits in my daily routine. It also encouraged me to try things I hadn’t even considered before.

The app includes really useful tools like a survival kit, guided movement exercises with guides, and many small details that make it feel supportive instead of overwhelming. The lore and the little companion system create a surprising sense of attachment and motivation — and that says a lot considering English isn’t even my first language.

But my review is especially about the small but outstanding team behind Finch. I had a minor issue recently, and they helped me quickly and efficiently, with better support than many much larger apps I’ve used.

10/10 from me!!

title: Great, but I don’t like the recent compications
body:
I loved this app, but recently it’s been getting so much complicated than it needs to be. Before you could just add a to-do item in a couple of clicks with a clean interface and now it’s all cluttered with time of day with icons, area, etc, and one more tap to open the keyboard after you tapped the “add” button. This complication really doesn’t sit right with me because it’s an app that is supposed to be helping people with depression, and adding more micro-decisions to people who already have trouble with seems unsupportive. Please make an option to simplify the interface. 

Otherwise, a great app. It has helped me get organized and feel like I don’t waste days, but doing something for myself.

You can change and customize all your goals, you can write reflections, practice breathing exercises and use soundscapes to sleep which are really helping me! I would recommend this to everyone, and specially those folks who feel stuck when trying to get everything done in their days :)

title: this app is AMAZING
body:
i’m in med school and want to be either a neurologist or a psychiatrist so i’m very much into mental health stuff
don’t let the cuteness deceive you, this has many scientifically based stuff that can help you
if you don’t have the means to go to therapy, there are some tools in here that could really help you until you can
i truly recommend you try this even if you don’t have any mental health problem (i’m feeling great and this is helping me a lot either way)

body:
